summary: Comprehensive frontend regression of SBC Guardian mobile prototype at 390x844. Verified onboarding, Home, EA FC Guardian flow (detected → finding → solution → review → applied → submit-confirm → submitted), all info sheets, all 4 error/state scenarios (noSolution, clubChanged, connectionError, offline), Protection presets + toggles + advanced settings, and Profile toasts + sign-out. Backend health endpoint verified.

issues: Backdrop dismiss area is only the strip above the sheet (top ~100px on 390x844). No explicit close 'X' or drag-to-dismiss handle. Users may not realise they can tap outside — consider adding a close affordance.

critical_code_review_comments: Sheet component (ui.jsx line 69-99): tapping the visible drag-handle at top of sheet does NOT close it — only clicks in the empty area above the sheet trigger onClose. Consider making the handle or a header button call onClose for better mobile UX.
GuardianContext scenario/toast/applied state is component-local and lost on page reload. This is fine for a prototype but should be noted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows validated via Playwright at 390x844. Note that: (1) closing bottom sheets via backdrop must click near the top of the screen — use element.click(position={x:20,y:20}, force=True) on the *-backdrop testid; (2) advanced-settings-panel is initially below the fold — call scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking info-prefer-untradeables/duplicates; (3) scenario state resets on page.reload() because it lives in React state, not localStorage — set scenario AFTER reload; (4) Applied/submitted state is component-local in EaFc.jsx and also resets on reload. Full test walkthrough executed and passed: onboarding, apply, submit, activity persistence, all 4 scenarios, protection toggles, sign-out.
